race.comment: OLE SPIRIT (9) makes strong appeal on debut after a comfortable Warwick Farm trial win and a narrow Rosehill trial placing. Looks to have plenty of ability on what we've seen publicly and she lands here in a country maiden. Can make a winning start to her career. SAKURIOUS (10) has race experience in her favour after a sound Wyong debut where she was slow away, picked up well and was beaten just under three lengths. LIGHTHORSEMAN (11) resumes in the easiest race he's seen on the back of some nice trials and he can't be discounted. MAYWEATHER (1) closed well last start when back to 1000m at Canberra and looks to have found his feet again. Can feature again stepping up to this trip now.
